notes: 1.0.38: The controller (Arduino) firmware can now be updated over the internet. The Update Firmware button pulls the latest controller firmware from the update channel, verifies it, and flashes it over USB - or falls back to the copy bundled with the app when offline. A new Check for update button shows the latest available version. That firmware has the servo drive as a direct RS485 connection. Includes the one-click-update reliability fix from 1.0.37.
